body:
I took two 50 mg tramdol pills. Roughly half an hour after taking the tramadol, I began to drink beer. After the first beer, I was experiencing potent and I mean potent euphoria. Waves of warmth overtoook my body and apathy and a carefree attitude overtook my mind. After the second beer, I was on the moon.
